scope: COV-017ar: dictionary-listed long contrast ending -지마는, preserving short -지만 and split 지 + 마는 alternatives.

senses.definition: 앞에 오는 말을 인정하면서 그와 반대되거나 다른 사실을 덧붙일 때 쓰는 연결 어미.

translations.definition: өмнөх агуулгыг хүлээн зөвшөөрч буй хирнээ түүнтэй эсрэгцэх буюу өөр утгыг нэмэх үед хэрэглэдэг холбох нөхцөл.
لاحقة للربط تُستخدم عند الحديث اعترافًا بكلامٍ سابق مع إضافة قولٍ يناقض مضمون ذلك الكلام أو ليس له علاقة مباشرة به
连接语尾。表示承认前面的话，同时添加与此相反或不同的事实。
Vĩ tố liên kết dùng khi công nhận vế trước đồng thời thêm vào sự việc đối lập hoặc khác với điều đó.
วิภัตติปัจจัยเชื่อมระหว่างประโยคที่ใช้เมื่อยอมรับคำพูดข้างหน้าพร้อมทั้งพูดเนื้อหาที่ขัดแย้งหรือไม่เหมือนกันกับคำพูดนั้น ๆ เพิ่มเติม
akhiran penghubung untuk menambahkan kenyataan yang berlawanan atau berbeda sambil mengakui isi anak kalimat.

Соединительное окончание, при котором в оформленной им придаточной части содержится допущение либо признание некого факта, а в последующей главной части следует противоречащий или не соответствующий ему факт.
A connective ending used to recognize the truth of the preceding statement and add facts that are the opposite of it or different.

translations.lemma: が。けれども。けれど。けど
translations.definition: 前の内容を認めながらもそれとは反対か異なる事実を付け加えて述べるのに用いる「連結語尾」。
Terminaison connective utilisée pour reconnaître la proposition précédente, tout en rajoutant un fait contraire ou différent.
Desinencia conectora que se usa cuando alguien acepta el contenido anterior pero agrega otro hecho o un hecho contario a él.

examples: 그 꽃이 아름답기는 하지마는 향기가 없다.
음악은 형태는 없지마는 무엇보다도 강한 힘을 가지고 있다.
운동을 안 하는 것도 문제이지마는 지나치게 과식하는 것도 큰 문제야.
notes: ‘이다’, 동사와 형용사 또는 ‘-었-’, ‘-겠-’ 뒤에 붙여 쓴다.

raw_judgments.review_status: Agent-authored, source-backed judgments; independent Korean-language review pending. Not a precision benchmark.

short_form_consistency.interpretation: Each added long-ending hypothesis has identical lemmas and morpheme roles in a prior short-지만 analysis. This checks consistency, not independent linguistic validity.

validation.rust: Passed full offline suite and stress; final focused tests cover both added split-reading judgments.
validation.browser: Passed full HTTP/browser suite; final two split-reading judgments and seventh UI selection additionally passed Nix-packaged verification. Desktop/mobile screenshots inspected.
validation.nix: Passed nix flake check and CLI/web builds on x86_64-linux.
validation.packaged_runtime: Passed all 79 judgments across 77 cases with the full dictionary and both filters, seven selected UI readings, source link, API/CLI/export parity, no page errors and desktop/mobile overflow checks; screenshots inspected.
validation.release_performance: Three interleaved release runs per version and filter completed; measurements retained below.

limitations: Agent-authored source-backed judgments, not independently annotated sentence truth or a precision estimate.
One outer 요 is an inferred connective extension; wider outer particle combinations are not added.
The six corpus targets already matched through other candidates. This batch adds the dictionary-listed ending structure, without claiming lemma recall gains.
KAIST 높으시지마는 is tagged 높+으시+지+만; original lemma and tags are preserved, including this segmentation difference.

All 282 added raw/novel analysis occurrences have a prior short-지만 counterpart. Consistency does not independently certify every dictionary-free root, copular alternative or contextual interpretation.
Existing negative auxiliary and nominal/copula hypotheses remain; source semantics, spacing and intended reading are not resolved.

performance.method: Three interleaved release CLI runs per version/filter, including startup, dictionary access and JSONL serialization; stdout discarded. Linux per-child peak RSS. Measurements do not establish statistical equivalence.
